title: HEADER, WINDSHIELD SIDE, & LOCK PILLAR WEATHERSTRIPS
summary: Weatherstrips around the door opening: the windshield pillar (A-pillar) side weatherstrip that the door glass seals against, screwed at its lower end through special washers and cemented; on convertibles (19467) also the header weatherstrip glued into the soft top's front bow where it meets the windshield header, and the lock pillar (B-pillar) weatherstrip with a wedge, held by screws and nuts. A fastener near the windshield side reveal molding goes in a drilled hole.
